verdict: Local search is your only active signal, and it's softening.
narrative: Across all three businesses this period, Google Business Profile was the sole source of engagement — no paid ads ran on any channel. Combined, your profiles generated 373 GBP actions (calls, direction requests, and website clicks) over the last 28 days, driven entirely by organic local search visibility. That foundation is showing cracks: GBP actions and search clicks declined week-over-week across all three entities, with the sharpest drops concentrated in the final three days of the period. The SEO root-cause fix and contact data work that unlocks the next phase of outreach are the priority this week, and resolving those opens the door to reactivating paid and email channels in October.

watch_item.fix: The web and SEO root-cause fix is being submitted this period, with all three sites targeted for reindexing by end of October.
